briefdescription.para: Application-level ValueTree owner — Single Source of Truth for all UI state.

detaileddescription.para: AppModel owns the root END ValueTree that holds window dimensions, tab layout, split pane configuration, and (via grafted subtrees) each terminal's session state.
Inherits jam::Model for the VT owner machinery and jam::Context<AppModel> so any subsystem can call AppModel::getContext() without passing references.

sect3.title: Mechanism
sect3.para: AppParameters.xml declares the schema. build() walks it and creates PARAM children + Parameter<int> adapters in the flat params AnyMap. All scalar reads use getValueFromChildWithID; all scalar writes use setValue. flush() syncs Parameters to VT on the 60 Hz timer; restoreValues() syncs VT back to Parameters after replaceState.

sect3.title: Serialization — three files, three concerns
sect3.para: ~/.config/end/window.state — WINDOW width/height only (standalone, cross-instance). Written by saveWindowState(). Read by loadWindowState().
~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.display — full state (WINDOW + TABS); daemon client writes on quit; daemon deletes on clean exit. Written by save(). Read on startup by load().
~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.nexus — plain-text port number only; daemon writes; daemon deletes on exit. Written by setPort(). Read by startup scan (plain text).

listitem.para: Daemon client owns .display (full state). Client never writes .nexus.
getStateFile() returns nexus/<uuid>.display (daemon client mode only).

sect3.title: Instance UUID
sect3.para: The ctor calls build() and overlays Lua runtime defaults. initialise() must call setInstanceUuid() first, then load() explicitly. File paths derive from the stored UUID and whether nexus mode is active. UUID is stored as a property on the root VT node using jam::ID::id.

sect3.title: Port
sect3.para: setPort(n) writes the port as plain text to <uuid>.nexus immediately.

sect3.title: Destructor
sect3.para: The dtor is trivial — no file I/O. Main owns all file decisions via systemRequestedQuit().

sect3.title: Thread model
sect3.para: All methods are called on the MESSAGE THREAD. atlasDirty is stored as a Parameter<int> in the flat params AnyMap — GL thread uses storeRelease/exchangeAcquire; message thread reads via consumeAtlasDirty().
